verdict.rationale: Evidence only hints that a JIRA integration exists (via a breach-related comment about stored credentials) and shows generic status states (Active/Resolved/Muted/Archived) plus PagerDuty/Slack/webhook integrations, but there is no documentation of Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear ticket linking, nor any two-way status sync where resolving a ticket closes the error and a regression reopens it. missing for 10: official Jira/GitHub Issues/Linear integration docs, description of two-way status sync, evidence of automatic reopen-on-regression behavior.
